title: Rail
subtitle: Your train journeys — every ride an entry of its own, like a flight.
betaNote: Beta. “Add journey” reads booking mails (.eml, .msg) and ticket PDFs.
empty: No train journeys yet. Add your first ride.
loadError: I couldn’t load your train journeys just now.

list.emptyHint: Add your first journey or read in a ticket.

deleteSurvivors.otherLegs_one: {{count}} other journey of the same booking
deleteSurvivors.otherLegs_other: {{count}} other journeys of the same booking
deleteSurvivors.bookingLegs: any other journeys of the same booking

deleteError: The journey could not be deleted.

form.stationMissing: Pick a station with a position — without it there is neither a map nor a distance.
form.timeHint: The time printed on the ticket. The time zone follows from the station.
form.delayNeedsClock: A delay needs the ride's times.
form.distanceHint: Leave empty: TravStats measures along the line taken from Transitous, otherwise the straight line. Fill it in when the ticket names the distance.
form.saveError: The journey could not be saved.

errors.arrivalBeforeDeparture: The arrival is before the departure. If the train runs overnight, give the arrival the next day's date.
errors.nonexistentTime: This time does not exist on that day: the clocks jump an hour ahead for summer time. Check the time on the ticket.
errors.invalidField: “{{field}}” was not accepted. Please check it.
errors.invalid: An entry was not accepted. Please check the fields.

form.suggestionsFailed: Suggestions from your earlier rides could not be loaded — the form works all the same.

missing.depCoordinates: valid coordinates of the departure station
missing.arrCoordinates: valid coordinates of the arrival station

station.searchPlaceholder: Search a station, e.g. Frankfurt Hbf
station.searchError: The station search cannot be reached right now.
station.noHits: No station found in the catalogue. Pick it through the place search.
station.useGeocoder: Not in the station catalogue? Pick it through the place search
station.noPlausibleHit: No station in the catalogue matches “{{name}}”. Search for the station in the field.

lookup.title: Look the train up
lookup.hint: Train number, departure station and day are enough — stops, times and the line come from the timetable.
lookup.needs: This needs a train number and a departure station.
lookup.pastDay: For past days the open timetable services rarely find anything: they only know the current timetable, a few weeks back. Just enter the journey by hand then.
lookup.error: The lookup failed. You can enter the journey by hand.

none.disabled: No timetable service is switched on here for this station.
none.unavailable: No answer from {{providers}} — so whether this train runs from this station on that day is still open. Try again later or enter the ride by hand.
none.noMatch: The timetable has no such train from this station on that day. For a past day that is normal.

outcome.skippedForTime: not asked — the search ran out of time

lookup.withLine: When you save, the line from Transitous is taken over and kept with the journey.
lookup.withoutLine: This source traces no line — the map shows the straight line.
lookup.linked: Linked to a journey from the timetable ({{provider}}).
lookup.switchedOff: The train lookup is switched off on this instance. Enter the journey by hand.
lookup.changeNeeded: Your destination {{station}} is not on this train's route. You change at {{stop}} — add the rest as a connection after saving.
lookup.applyWithChange: Take over up to the change

detail.loadError: The journey could not be loaded.
detail.notFound: This journey does not exist (any more).
detail.convertedPlaceholder: The departure was a placeholder (12:00 on the station's clock) and the arrival is unknown — please correct both from the ticket.
detail.lineTraced: Line: this train's route, taken from Transitous.
detail.lineRoadtrip: Line: brought over from the roadtrip — as planned, not from a timetable.
detail.lineStraight: Line: straight line between the stations — not the train's path.
detail.lineRouted: Line: routed over the rail network (OpenRailRouting, OpenStreetMap) — the likely path, not from a timetable.
detail.lineRoutedDemo: Line: routed over the rail network (BRouter, OpenStreetMap) — the likely path, not from a timetable.

connection.banner: Connecting train from {{station}} — both rides are joined by one booking.
connection.title: Connection
connection.onward: Onward to {{station}}: after saving, the connection opens with this destination.
connection.loadError: The journey could not be loaded.
connection.notFound: This journey does not exist (any more).

stats.loadError: The rail statistics could not be loaded.
stats.empty: No completed train ride logged yet.
stats.kmStraight: {{km}} km straight line (the real track is longer)
stats.noDelays: No ride has a recorded delay.
stats.nightTrainsDesc: sleeper or couchette, a night-train category, or overnight on board
stats.crossBorderDesc: departure and arrival in different countries

roadtripConversion.title: Take over as train rides
roadtripConversion.offer: This roadtrip has “Rail” as its vehicle — from before train journeys became an area of their own. You can take it over into the rail logbook: one train ride per section between two stations.
roadtripConversion.loadError: The preview could not be loaded.
roadtripConversion.placeholder: Each departure is a placeholder at 12:00 local time and the arrival is unknown — correct them from the ticket afterwards.
roadtripConversion.removeSectionHint: Only possible when every section can be taken over.
roadtripConversion.removeSectionCostsHint: Not possible: the roadtrip has recorded costs and belongs to no trip that could take them over.
roadtripConversion.nothingNew: Every ride had already been taken over.

geometryNotice.straight: Ride saved, but without its route – {{reason}}. The map shows the straight line.
geometryNotice.kept: Ride saved. The route was not loaded again – {{reason}}; the previous one is kept.
geometryNotice.routed: Ride saved. This train's own route was not available – {{reason}}; the line was routed over the rail network instead.

reason.providerDisabled: Transitous is switched off on this instance
reason.stationOffLine: a station is not on this train's route
reason.untracedShape: Transitous only has straight lines between this train's stops
reason.railRoutingUnavailable: this instance's rail router (OpenRailRouting) did not answer
reason.railRoutingNoRoute: the rail router (OpenRailRouting) knows no track connection between these stations

import.panelHint: Got a booking confirmation or a ticket? Drop the mail (.eml, .msg) or the PDF here — the rides are read and you confirm each one.
import.title: Review the rides read
import.totalNotWritten: A ride of this booking is already logged — the total is not saved a second time.
import.noTrain: no train number on the ticket
import.duplicate: Already in your logbook (same booking, same departure) — not ticked.
import.unresolved: “{{name}}” is not unambiguous in the station catalogue. Pick the station:
import.pickStations: Pick both stations for every ticked ride — without a station the time cannot be placed in a time zone.
import.saved_one: {{count}} train ride saved from the ticket.
import.saved_other: {{count}} train rides saved from the ticket.

empty.noItinerary: This rail mail names booking {{reference}} but no itinerary. It is in the attached ticket PDF — upload the PDF, or the mail with its attachment (.eml/.msg).
empty.llmUnreachable: No train ride was recognised in this document: no template knows the layout, and the AI parser is not reachable. Enter the ride by hand.
empty.llmFailed: The AI parser gave no usable answer for this document. Enter the ride by hand.
empty.demoNoLlm: No template knows this ticket, and the AI parser is not available to the demo account.
empty.llmDisabled: No template knows this ticket, and the administrator has switched the AI parser off.
empty.nothingFound: No train ride was found in this document. Enter the ride by hand.
empty.otherDomain: This document is not a rail booking. Import it where it belongs.
empty.looksLikeFlight: The AI parser read airport codes instead of stations — the document is probably a flight booking. Nothing was taken over.
empty.llmCloudNotConsented: No template knows this ticket, and the AI provider is outside the network without the administrator's consent to send it there.
empty.llmProviderIncomplete: No template knows this ticket, and the AI provider is not fully set up.

reservation.title: Apply a seat reservation
reservation.intro: This is a reservation, not a ticket. No new journey is created — the coach and seat go onto journeys already in your logbook.
reservation.done_one: {{count}} seat added to an existing journey.

status.attach: The coach and seat will be recorded on this journey.
status.change: This journey already has coach {{coach}}, seat {{seat}}. Only if you tick it is that replaced by the reserved one.
status.alreadySet: This seat is already recorded on the journey — nothing to do.
status.several_one: {{count}} journey fits — none is chosen. Enter the seat on the right journey by hand:
status.several_other: {{count}} journeys fit (same train, same day) — none is chosen. Enter the seat on the right journey by hand:
status.sameJourneyTwice: Another section of this reservation belongs to the same journey — which seat applies is unclear. Enter it by hand.

none.noJourney: No matching journey in your logbook (same train, same day, matching stations) — nothing is recorded.
none.noTrain: The reservation names no train — it cannot be matched to a journey.
none.noSeat: The reservation names neither coach nor seat — nothing to record.

transfer.unknownWhy: One of the two times is missing or known only by its date.
transfer.conflict: Time conflict: the next train leaves {{wait}} before this one arrives.
transfer.shortHint: Hint: less than {{minutes}} min to change. Whether the connection works out, TravStats cannot know.
transfer.separate: A separate ride – not a change
transfer.markFailed: The mark could not be saved. Please try again.
transfer.orderUnknown: Change unknown: a ride on this day is recorded by its date only, so the order of the trains is not known.

connectionView.documentsFailed: The documents of this ride could not be loaded.
connectionView.documentsBelow: Documents of this ride: in the “Documents” section below.
